lines: Heard by me, all — Rudrayāmala-born:
the Trika's divisions, essence by essence run.
sanskrit_cite: śrutaṃ deva mayā sarvaṃ rudrayāmalasambhavam | trikabhedam aśeṣeṇa sārāt sāravibhāgaśaḥ

lines: Even now the doubt is not dispelled in me —
what form is it in truth, made of word-heap and digit?
sanskrit_cite: adyāpi na nivṛtto me saṃśayaḥ parameśvara | kiṃ rūpaṃ tattvato deva śabdarāśikalāmayam

lines: Nine-self division? Bhairava in his form?
three-head split? power-triad? which is it?
sanskrit_cite: kiṃ vā navātmabhedena bhairave bhairavākṛtau | triśirobhedabhinnaṃ vā kiṃ vā śaktitrayātmakam

lines: Nāda's drop, the moon-crescent's checks —
or wheel-mounted, unsmeared: power-formed, what?
sanskrit_cite: nādabindumayaṃ vāpi kiṃ candrārdhanirodhikāḥ | cakrārūḍham anackaṃ vā kiṃ vā śaktisvarūpakam

lines: Higher and lower, whole: and of the lower —
if higher then were that, its higher-ness contradicts.
sanskrit_cite: parāparāyāḥ sakalam aparāyāś ca vā punaḥ | parāyā yadi tadvat syāt paratvaṃ tad virudhyate

lines: Not by letter-division, nor by bodies divided:
higher-ness is partlessness — that, not, in wholeness.
sanskrit_cite: na hi varṇavibhedena dehabhedena vā bhavet | paratvaṃ niṣkalatvena sakalatve na tad bhavet

lines: Grant grace, O Lord — cut the doubt entire:
what you were asked, is the tantra's very essence.
sanskrit_cite: prasādaṃ kuru me nātha niḥśeṣaṃ chinddhi saṃśayam | sādhu sādhu tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tantrasāram idam priye

lines: Most worthy of hiding, fortunate one —
yet will I tell you: all Bhairava's form, proclaimed.
sanskrit_cite: gūhanīyatamam bhadre tathāpi kathayāmi te | yatkiṃcit sakalaṃ rūpaṃ bhairavasya prakīrtitam

lines: Known by its own unsubstantialness, Goddess —
Indra-net, māyā's dream, the Gandharva-city's error.
sanskrit_cite: tad asāratayā devi vijñeyaṃ śakrajālavat | māyāsvapnopamaṃ caiva gandharvanagarabhramam

lines: For meditation's sake — confused minds, pompous-rite
dwellers: described merely, fancy-struck men.
sanskrit_cite: dhyānārtham bhrāntabuddhīnāṃ kriyāḍambaravartinām | kevalaṃ varṇitam puṃsāṃ vikalpanihatātmanām
